2608.19073.title: Robust Risk Under Evolving Uncertainty: A Wasserstein Counterpart of the Entropic Value-at-Risk
2608.19073.paper_summary: An agent still learning its environment should be cautious while ignorant and bold once confident. The entropic value-at-risk captures this through a robust-optimization identity---a confidence level fixes the radius of a relative-entropy ball of alternative models---but that ball cannot reach catastrophes the nominal deems impossible, precisely what a safe agent must hedge. We instead use an optimal-transport ball and study the coherent risk measure it induces, the Wasserstein entropic value-at-risk. It has a variational dual mirroring the entropic formula (an inverse temperature becomes a transport price), occupies a definite place in the risk hierarchy, and provably accounts for the reachable catastrophes the entropic measure ignores; we verify both dualities numerically. Driving the transport radius by belief entropy then yields a closed-form robust dynamic-programming operator whose caution contracts as the belief sharpens, with a certified safety sandwich and a sharp safety switch.
2608.19073.paper_summary_zh: 一個仍在學習其環境的代理應該在無知時保持謹慎，而在有信心時則應該大膽。熵值風險捕捉了這一點，通過一個穩健優化的身份——一個置信水平固定了替代模型的相對熵球的半徑——但該球無法達到名義上認為不可能的災難，這正是安全代理必須對沖的部分。我們則使用最優傳輸球，並研究其所引發的相干風險度量，即瓦瑟斯坦熵值風險。它有一個變分對偶，映射到熵公式（逆溫度變成傳輸價格），在風險層級中占據明確的位置，並且可以證明考慮到熵度量所忽略的可達災難；我們對這兩個對偶進行了數值驗證。通過信念熵驅動傳輸半徑，然後產生一個封閉形式的穩健動態規劃算子，其謹慎性隨著信念的明確而收縮，並伴隨著經過認證的安全夾層和銳利的安全開關。
2608.19073.author: Deep Kumar Ganguly et.al.
